description: Converts one of your organisation's purchased Shoot Plan plans into a dpl.plan/1 plan in the short-form profile, so you can pass it to shoot_plan_check. It is the same conversion dpl-eil's reference importer makes, and it is one way only. Input: planId (the plan's planId, spp_..., as shown inside shoot_plan_get) or taskId (the full taskId from shoot_plan_list); optionally dayStart (HH:MM, default 09:00: the clock time of minute 0 of the shoot) and date (YYYY-MM-DD). Output: {plan, report}. The report lists every field of the Shoot Plan plan that has no place in DPL or was approximated, with counts, and anything it had to assume. It also uses the structured details the plan was made from (people's names, access windows, how noisy each place is) when Shoot Plan holds them; where it does not, those come back as gaps. The private context text is never used. Read-only: the Shoot Plan plan is not changed and the DPL plan is not stored, so keep it yourself. The plan must belong to the organisation of your agent key. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account, and a Shoot Plan you have bought. No AI model runs. It never counts toward the monthly allowance. Documents made from a plan you have bought do not use up a project, but they do count towards the fair-use limits. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

dayStart.description: Clock time of minute 0 of the shoot, HH:MM. Default 09:00.

planId.description: The plan's planId (spp_...), as shown inside shoot_plan_get. Give this or taskId.

taskId.description: The taskId from shoot_plan_list. Give this or planId.

name: shoot_plan_to_dpl
title: Convert a Shoot Plan you have bought into a DPL plan
